name: NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
operator: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), U.S. Department of Commerce
tier_rationale: U.S. government body (A8 trusted: government bodies; CISA/NVD named among the trusted operators); P183 cond 7 'Registry providers mitre and nist_nvd: tier trusted, terms open'.

reliability.justification: Government analysis of the CVE List: NVD-assessed CVSS, CWE and CPE applicability configurations; curated reference data, not observations (analysis can lag publication).

error_markers.regex: (?i)\A(?![\s\S]*(?:challenge-platform|_cf_chl_opt|cf-chl|just a moment|attention required|you have been blocked|captcha))
error_markers.reason: NVD API: HTTP 403 - the rolling 30 s window was exceeded (5 requests keyless, 50 with key 'nvd'): could not verify, retry later

nvd.description: NVD API key (header apiKey): raises the NVD limit from 5 to 50 requests per rolling 30 s and enables NVD keyword search in cve_record
nvd.plan_hint: free key requested under the corporate identity by the team (one team account, A15); NVD data stays public domain with or without it

cve_api.title: NVD CVE API 2.0 /rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId= (CPE configurations, NVD-assessed CVSS/CWE; keywordSearch only with key 'nvd')

terms.quote: Notices: 'This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.' wherever NVD data appears (v3lum info, report footer); MITRE's CVE/CWE copyright designation and licence in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. Registry providers mitre and nist_nvd: tier trusted, terms open.

cve_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P183 cond 7); research C0432 terms 'NIST public data' / 'US public domain' (verified_live 200; services.nvd.nist.gov now behind Cloudflare: server cloudflare, __cf_bm cookies - never stored, A10). Called only when CPE configurations are needed (seed CVEs or has_vuln on an org asset) or key 'nvd' is set (P183 cond 1); keyless budget 10 calls per case (setting cve_record_nvd_case_budget). Limits: 5 requests per rolling 30 s keyless, 50 with a key; the quota block is the keyless figure at 80% (keyed callers stay conservative). A bad parameter answers 404 with an empty body and the reason in the 'message' header; a 403 without a challenge page is the documented rolling-window signal (marker nist_nvd.rolling_window_403 -> rate_limited, provider signal wins, P334 cond 8); a Cloudflare challenge stays BLOCKED/challenge. Required notice: 'This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.'

web_pages.title: NVD vulnerability detail pages nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/{cve} (manual pivot links only: single-page app behind a bot check)

terms.quote: NVD web pages are an SPA: links only.

web_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P183 cond 1). Research C0432: the detail page shows a bot-check page to scripted clients, so V3LUM never fetches it; modules add it to their results as a link (res.link), never fetched.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G08-1 (P183 cve_record). Other batches extend it (nist_nvd__<suffix>.json). One key per provider: 'nvd' (env alias V3LUM_NVD_KEY, team account). NVD error channel: 404 + 'message' header for bad parameters (apiKey in the message -> the key was refused), 403 for the rolling window, Cloudflare challenge pages for bot management (never retried or bypassed, A9).
